title: Unique Bitter Jamaican Chicken Skewers
description: A quick-fix Jamaican dish featuring cider vinegar and wok-hei, these bitter chicken skewers are perfect for a snack or dinner. The combination of spices and vinegar gives the dish a unique flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together cider vinegar, soy sauce, brown sugar, scotch bonnet pepper, thyme, and garlic.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill or grill pan with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, heat a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Once the chicken is done, add it to the wok and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes to develop the wok-hei flavor.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional thyme if desired.
